edition.authority: Congregation for Divine Worship and the Discipline of the Sacraments
edition.notes: This one-page notice precedes the separately titled Latin variation list and Supplementum at printed pp. 368-387. It reports the earlier approving decree rather than constituting that decree.
edition.title: Reimpressio emendata 'Missalis Romani'

passages.context: The complete notice was inspected. It identifies the 2008 book as an emended reprint rather than a new typical edition, states the general pagination boundary, acknowledges textual and presentational corrections, identifies the omitted children's Eucharistic Prayers and added dismissal alternatives, and names the printer and seller.
passages.notes: This passage controls only the published description of the reprint's character and scope. It is not a substitute for direct inspection of the 2008 altar-book pages or the separate decree Prot. N. 652/08/L.
passages.reason: The rights record states that lawful project access to this artifact does not include redistribution from this repository.
passages.rights_basis: The exact modern journal issue is publicly delivered by the responsible Holy See dicastery, but the issue contains modern editorial, typographic, liturgical, and scholarly material and no artifact-level redistribution license was located. Online official availability alone is not repository redistribution permission.

alternate_titles: Notice concerning the 2008 emended reprint of the Missale Romanum
work.author: Congregation for Divine Worship and the Discipline of the Sacraments
work.description: The Italian status notice published at Notitiae p. 367 that explains the character, scope, pagination, and publication of the 2008 emended reprint. It is distinct from both the complete altar book and the separately promulgated decree Prot. N. 652/08/L.
work.title: Reimpressio emendata 'Missalis Romani'
